create_pooler_config: create a PoolerConfig instance to control output pooling behavior for embedding and classification models
configure_seq_pooling_type: configure sequence pooling type using CLS, LAST, or MEAN pooling methods for pooling models
enable_chunked_processing: enable chunked processing for long inputs to handle arbitrarily long text without CUDA errors
apply_platt_scaling: apply affine score calibration (Platt scaling) using logit_mean and logit_sigma for classification logits
compute_pooler_config_hash: compute a hash that uniquely identifies the PoolerConfig for caching and reproducibility
